result.topic_en: The opening page of the 'Old unsolved questions' section, reprinting the start of question 730 (1865), about determinants formed from the power sums of the roots of an equation with binomial coefficients.
result.transcription:
ANCIENNES QUESTIONS NON RÉSOLUES.

730 (1865, 142) — Supposons que $s_0$, $s_1$, ... représentent les sommes des puissances zéro, première, etc., des racines de l'équation
$$a_0 x^n + n a_1 x^{n-1} + \frac{n(n-1)}{1.2} a_2 n^{n-2}$$
$$+ \frac{n(n-1)(n-2)}{1.2.3} a_3 x^{n-3} + \ldots = 0$$
Si
$$\begin{vmatrix} S_0 & S_1 \\ S_1 & S_2 \end{vmatrix} < 0 \qquad \begin{vmatrix} S_0 & S_1 & S_2 [?] \\ S_1 & S_2 & S_3 \\ S_2 & S_3 & S_4 \end{vmatrix} > 0,$$

questions.statement_en:
Suppose that $s_0$, $s_1$, ... represent the sums of the zeroth, first, etc. powers of the roots of the equation
$$a_0 x^n + n a_1 x^{n-1} + \frac{n(n-1)}{1.2} a_2 n^{n-2} + \frac{n(n-1)(n-2)}{1.2.3} a_3 x^{n-3} + \ldots = 0$$
If
$$\begin{vmatrix} S_0 & S_1 \\ S_1 & S_2 \end{vmatrix} < 0 \qquad \begin{vmatrix} S_0 & S_1 & S_2 [?] \\ S_1 & S_2 & S_3 \\ S_2 & S_3 & S_4 \end{vmatrix} > 0,

result.notes_en: The page carries only the section heading 'Anciennes questions non résolues' (Old unsolved questions) and no other editorial text. The third term of the equation is printed as '$a_2 n^{n-2}$' (very likely a misprint for $a_2 x^{n-2}$) and is transcribed as printed. The text uses lowercase $s_i$, while the determinants use capital $S_i$. The top-right entry of the 3x3 determinant is poorly printed and is read as $S_2$.
